final: WITH p AS (SELECT P.ID, P.SEX, AVG(L.ALB) AS alb, AVG(CASE WHEN L."T-BIL" IS NOT NULL AND L."T-BIL" <> 0 THEN CAST(L.UN AS REAL) / L."T-BIL" END) AS r FROM Laboratory L JOIN Patient P ON P.ID = L.ID GROUP BY P.ID, P.SEX), s AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(alb) AS avg_alb, AVG(r) AS avg_ratio FROM p GROUP BY SEX) SELECT SEX, avg_alb, avg_ratio, avg_alb - (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM s) AS diff_above_mean FROM s WHERE avg_alb > (SELECT AVG(avg_alb) FROM s)
